meta.title: Immigration
meta.question: Should Poland welcome immigrants and refugees?
meta.measure: Average position on immigration and refugees, from 0 (open) to 10 (restrictive)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on admitting immigrants and refugees and on their effects on the country, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: If many refugees come from the USSR, should the government let all of them stay (0), only some (5), or send them all back (10)?
What should the government do about people from other countries coming here to work: let anyone come ... prohibit people coming?
When jobs are scarce, employers should give priority to Polish people over immigrants
items.notes: World Values Survey 1997, 2005, 2012 (3 usable surveys). The 1989 wave falls before CAL_START (January 1990) and is left out by the pipeline.

items.wording: Would not like to have immigrants or foreign workers as neighbours
What should the government do about people from less developed countries coming here to work: let anyone come ... prohibit people coming?
When jobs are scarce, employers should give priority to Polish people over immigrants (agree / neither / disagree)
Would not like to have immigrants or foreign workers as neighbours
items.notes: European Values Study 1990, 1999, 2008 (3 surveys). 2017 is EVS_NBR_IMMIG17.

items.wording: Should foreigners be allowed to take any job in Poland (0), only some kinds (5), or none (10)?
Is the presence of Ukrainians in Poland beneficial or harmful for the country?
Is the presence of Vietnamese people in Poland beneficial or harmful for the country?
Would people from other countries settling here make Poland a better or a worse place to live and work?
Is the influence of immigrants very good, somewhat good, somewhat bad or very bad for the country?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2002, 2007 (2 surveys). Many don't knows (2002: 31%).

items.wording: Are there not many, a lot but not too many, or too many people of another nationality living in the country? ('no foreigners at all' is no position)
Immigration bad or good for the economy
Allow many or few immigrants of a different race or ethnic group
Allow many or few immigrants from poorer countries outside Europe
Allow many or few immigrants of the same race or ethnic group as the majority
Do immigrants take jobs away or create new jobs?
Cultural life undermined or enriched by immigrants
Immigrants make the country a worse or better place to live
The right to asylum in the country should be made easier to obtain
Legally established immigrants should have the same social rights as the country's citizens
All immigrants, whether legal or illegal, should be sent back to their country of origin
All illegal immigrants should be sent back to their country of origin without exception
Should foreigners persecuted for their political beliefs have the right to settle in Poland (0), to stay until they can return (5), or no right (10)?
Is the presence of Arabs in Poland beneficial or harmful for the country?
Does Poland need (more) immigrants, people who come to settle here?
For greater security, would you accept tighter migration rules?
items.notes: CBOS 2005-08, 2015-03, 2015-12, 2016-08 (4 surveys); the security battery of the law-and-order wiretap items.

items.wording: The authorities should encourage vs counteract foreigners settling in Poland, 0-10
Should it be made easier for non-EU foreigners to work in Poland in jobs no Poles want?
Immigrants contribute a lot to (our country)
items.notes: Eurobarometer 2006, 2008, 2012, 2014, 2015 x2, 2016 x2, 2017 x2, 2018 x2, 2019 x2, 2020 (15 surveys). In 2008 a second copy for the Turkish Cypriot community comes after the main one. From 2023 the wording is 'contribute positively' (EB_IMMIG_CONTRIB_POS).

items.wording: Are strict limits on immigration always, sometimes or never right?
Immigrants make crime problems worse (1) ... do not (10)
Immigrants undermine the country's cultural life (1) ... do not (10)
items.notes: European Values Study 2008 (1 survey). Also in Integration of immigrants, as ESS_IMUECLT is.

items.wording: Immigrants take jobs away from Poles (1) ... do not (10)
Nowadays I feel like a stranger in my own country because of all the immigrants
Immigrants will in the future become a threat to society (1) ... will not (10)
There are too many immigrants in the country
Immigrants are a strain on the welfare system (1) ... are not (10)
Immigration to Poland should be decreased significantly
Immigrants today make our country stronger because of their work and talents (0), or are a burden because they take our jobs and social benefits (10)?
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2014, 2018 (2 surveys). The statement order is in the variable label; 'both/neither' (volunteered) placed at 5.

items.wording: Should we allow more immigrants into the country, fewer, or about the same as now?
Does immigration of people from outside the EU evoke a positive or negative feeling for you?
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer, November 2014 to March 2026 (18 surveys).

items.wording: Should Poland accept some of the refugees arriving in Europe (from the Middle East and Africa)?
Should Poland accept refugees from countries at war (and let them settle; until they can return; not at all)?
Should Poland accept Ukrainian refugees from the areas of the conflict?
(Our country) should help refugees
Would accepting refugees lower the level of security in Poland (10) or not affect it (0)?
Settlement of foreigners, as above, 1-7
Refugees make our country stronger (0), or are a burden because they take our jobs and social benefits (10)?
Refugees today are more to blame for crime than other groups (10), or no more (0)?
Refugees will increase the likelihood of terrorism in our country (10), or will not (0)?
Is a large number of refugees leaving countries such as Iraq and Syria a major threat, a minor threat or not a threat to the country?

Foreigners should not be allowed to settle permanently in Poland
Would you feel comfortable or uncomfortable having an immigrant as a neighbour?
Immigrants take jobs away from workers in (our country)
Is immigration from outside the EU more of a problem (10), more of an opportunity (0), or equally both (5)?
items.notes: Special Eurobarometer on integration 2017 and 2021 (2 surveys).

items.wording: Immigrants are a burden on our welfare system
How would you evaluate the impact of immigrants on the development of the country? (very bad ... very good)
As EVS_JOBS_NATIONALS_3, five points
Would not like to have immigrants or foreign workers as neighbours
items.notes: European Values Study 2017 (1 survey). Italy's experimental wordings fail the regex.

items.wording: Would you support or oppose encouraging highly skilled people to immigrate and work in the country?
Immigrants today are more to blame for crime than other groups (10), or no more to blame (0)?
As PEW_IMMIG_MORELESS14; 2018 adds a volunteered 'no immigrants at all' (20% in Poland), placed at 10, with 'fewer' at 8
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2018 (1 survey). Kept apart from 2014 because of the volunteered answer; the regex relies on the question number.

items.wording: Immigrants today increase the risk of terrorism in our country (10), or no more so than other groups (0)?

Poland should accept refugees arriving in Europe from Africa and the Middle East (1) vs should not (7)
items.notes: CBOS's two-statement cards, 2019, 2021, 2023 (two surveys pooled each), reports only (mean and SD in Table 2). In 2025 replaced by a card on migrants generally.
